Subject: Join KRDU's Spring Volunteer Team — Training Starts May 6

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for signing up at the activities fair last week. I'm writing to let you know that KRDU, the campus radio station, is now recruiting volunteers for the spring semester, and we'd love to have you on the team.

We have openings on the news desk, in the music library, and on the overnight broadcast crew. Most volunteers commit to two four-hour shifts per month, but news desk members usually do three. Training begins Saturday, May 6, from 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM in the basement of Hollis Hall, Room B12. It's free to attend, and no prior broadcasting experience is needed. Because the station's card readers are being replaced, all new volunteers must pay a $10 deposit for their access badge at the first session; the money is refunded in June when you return the badge.

If you cannot make the May 6 session, we're offering a second training on Wednesday, May 10, from 6:00 to 9:00 PM. Please reply to this message by May 3 so our program director, Dana Whitfield, can assign your shifts.

Best regards,
Priya Raman
Volunteer Coordinator, KRDU

Subject: Welcome to the Eastside Bike Kitchen — Membership Details

Dear Riverside residents,

The Eastside Bike Kitchen, a volunteer-run repair space two blocks from the university's north gate, is now accepting members for the summer season. Unlike a commercial shop, we lend professional tools, repair stands, and wheel-truing equipment to anyone who completes a short orientation.

Membership is open to students and community members alike. For $25 per semester, members may use the workshop during open hours: Tuesdays and Thursdays from 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM, and Saturdays from 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM. A volunteer mechanic is always on hand to answer questions, but members are expected to carry out their own repairs. First-time visitors must attend a 30-minute orientation covering tool checkout and safety procedures; sessions run every Saturday at 9:30 AM and cost nothing extra. Members who misplace a borrowed tool are charged the replacement price, so please sign each item back in before you leave.

To register, bring your student or state ID to the front desk. Space is limited to 120 members per term, and the summer waitlist typically fills by late May.

Thanks,
Owen Baptiste
Membership Coordinator

Subject: You're Invited — Chess Club Blitz Night, Friday, October 11

Dear Club Members and Friends,

The Riverside University Chess Club invites you to our first Blitz Night of the semester. Whether you have played for years or only just learned the rules, come join us for a relaxed evening of fast games, snacks, and friendly competition.

The event takes place on Friday, October 11, from 6:00 to 9:00 PM in the Student Union, Room 214. Games last five minutes per player, and we will run a short beginners' table for anyone who wants to practice first. Pizza and drinks are provided at no cost, thanks to the Student Activities Fund. Please bring your own board if you have one; our eight club sets usually fill up quickly.

Prizes for the top three players include club T-shirts and a $15 gift card to the campus bookstore. Sign-up is not required, but if you let us know you're coming by Wednesday, October 9, we'll save you a seat.

See you there!
Amara Osei
Events Chair, Riverside University Chess Club
